construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit PDC17-046 (PD Zoning, folder year 2017), status Approved, issue date 2020-12-01: "Planned Development Rezoning to rezone from the R-M Multiple Residence District to a Planned Development Zoning District to facilitate a development with six (6) residential townhomes on an approximately 0.46-gross acre site."

Council resolution (draft, item 10.2(b), 2020-12-01): two 3-story buildings of three attached townhomes each, maximum height 34 ft 2 in, about 13 units per acre, minimum lot size 1,300 sq ft, at least 400 sq ft private open space per unit, new private street; replaces a 2,400 sq ft single-family house, garage and shed. Tentative map application filed by Margaret Pham of Berryessa Homes Development on behalf of William and Nancy Hoang.
Planning Commission date differs by source: the Commission memorandum gives November 18, 2020; the draft resolution gives November 17, 2020.

City permits layer, 2026: AD26-356 (filed 2026-05-28, under review) for a one-year extension of PD19-022 to July 2, 2027; T26-010 vesting tentative map for six residential parcels and one common parcel and ER26-089 environmental review (both filed 2026-06-03, under review), applicant Margaret Pham (Elite Realty Services).
